seo.title: Verdana Table — Where Nature Meets Flavor
seo.description: A botanical dining experience celebrating seasonal ingredients, organic wines, and the art of slow food in a lush garden setting.
seo.keywords: restaurant, botanical, organic, seasonal, garden dining, fine dining

hero.headline: A garden on your plate
hero.subtext: Seasonal ingredients, curated with love, served in a lush botanical setting that awakens every sense.

about.headline: Rooted in tradition, grown with passion
about.body: Verdana Table was born from a simple belief: the best meals start in the soil. Our chef partners with local farms to bring you dishes that celebrate the rhythm of the seasons. Every plate tells a story of sun, rain, and patient hands.

reviews.name: Sophia M.
reviews.text: An absolutely magical evening. The garden setting, the flavors — everything felt like a dream. We'll be back every season.

reviews.name: James T.
reviews.text: The wild mushroom risotto alone is worth the visit. The attention to seasonal ingredients is something you rarely find.

reviews.name: Amara K.
reviews.text: We celebrated our anniversary here and it was perfect. Intimate, thoughtful, and the pavlova was heavenly.

reviews.name: Luca R.
reviews.text: Finally a restaurant that takes plant-based dining seriously. The Garden Harvest Bowl is a masterpiece.

reviews.name: Elena V.
reviews.text: The botanical cocktails are inventive and refreshing. The lavender lemonade is summer in a glass.
